name: click_element
description: Click an interactive element (button, link, tab, row, checkbox) on the active page. Supports standard CSS selectors, ARIA role selectors (e.g. 'role=button[name="Archive"]'), or plain text matching (e.g. 'Atmos Energy', 'Submit'). Automatically filters for visible elements and falls back to container bubbling / JS dispatch.

selector.description: CSS selector, ARIA role selector ('role=button[name="..."]'), or plain text of the element to click.

timeout_ms.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 10000.
